about.title: About
about.intro: I build product experiences that feel polished on the surface and dependable underneath.
about.p1: My work sits at the intersection of UI craft, frontend engineering, and system thinking. I care about speed, accessibility, and giving teams a visual language they can keep extending.
about.p2: Over the years I've worked on design systems, dashboards, e-commerce, internal tools, and launch surfaces. The throughline is always the same: make complex things feel legible.
about.exp1Desc: Lead frontend for the main product. Introduced design system and improved Core Web Vitals.
about.exp2Desc: Built customer dashboard and admin panel with React. Integrated REST and GraphQL APIs.
about.exp3Desc: Developed responsive sites and small web apps. Worked with designers and backend team.
about.manifestoBody: I like products that feel deliberate: clear hierarchy, thoughtful motion, stable architecture, and just enough personality to be memorable.

projects.description: Five projects I shipped and still stand behind. Each one lists the role I held, the stack I used and what actually changed at the end.
